message.abstract: <jats:p>We give a minimum degree condition sufficient to ensure the existence of a fractional<jats:italic>K<jats:sub>r</jats:sub></jats:italic>-decomposition in a balanced<jats:italic>r</jats:italic>-partite graph (subject to some further simple necessary conditions). This generalizes the non-partite problem studied recently by Barber, Lo, Kühn, Osthus and the author, and the 3-partite fractional<jats:italic>K</jats:italic><jats:sub>3</jats:sub>-decomposition problem studied recently by Bowditch and Dukes. Combining our result with recent work by Barber, Kühn, Lo, Osthus and Taylor, this gives a minimum degree condition sufficient to ensure the existence of a (non-fractional)<jats:italic>K<jats:sub>r</jats:sub></jats:italic>-decomposition in a balanced<jats:italic>r</jats:italic>-partite graph (subject to the same simple necessary conditions).</jats:p>
title: Fractional Clique Decompositions of Dense Partite Graphs
